title: Silent Wake — Classic (EXCON)
description: Classic (GM-driven) variant of Silent Wake with manual injects, ETBOL PT/RT split. 3 turns.

content.briefing: You are the crew of a Frigate on independent transit to patrol sector Alpha-3. NLT 112000B arrival. Transit time approx. 6 hrs at planned speed 15 kts. Regional posture: heightened readiness. ROE: Weapons Tight. Intelligence indicates possible hostile naval presence in theatre with potential use of visual and electronic deception tactics. No escort assigned. All systems nominal. Organic helicopter joins upon arrival.
objectives: Maintain mission tempo through escalating anomalies
Identify and respond to AIS spoofing and cyber intrusion
rules: ROE: Weapons Tight — do not engage unless positively identified as hostile and authorised.
CO selects up to 2 blue cards per turn after hearing advisor recommendations.

events.title: Turn 1 — In Transit
events.description: Transit proceeding as planned. All systems nominal. No contacts of concern. EMCON: Navigation radar only.

events.title: Turn 2 — Subtle Anomalies
events.description: Speed discrepancy detected. Ghost AIS contact bearing 035 / 18 nm with no radar echo or ESM emissions.

events.title: Turn 3 — Faulty Component / Increased Traffic
events.description: Faulty speed component identified (ETBOL 5 min). AIS traffic density increasing beyond expected baseline.

issues.title: Transit — All Systems Nominal
issues.description: All systems Green. NAV RADAR, IBMS/INS, COMMS ON. Weapons OFF.

issues.title: Speed Discrepancy + Ghost AIS Contact
issues.description: SOG vs STW mismatch. AIS contact bearing 035 / 18 nm with no radar echo.

decision_templates.title: Turn 1 — Choose your actions
decision_templates.description: Transit proceeding as planned. Systems nominal. No contacts of concern. Select up to 2 cards from your available options.

decision_templates.title: Turn 2 — Choose your actions
decision_templates.description: Speed discrepancy detected. Ghost AIS contact bearing 035 / 18 nm. Select up to 2 cards.

turns.title: In Transit
turns.facilitator_prompt: Transit proceeding as planned. Deliver role-targeted injects. Emphasise that this is a calm baseline — players should establish communication rhythm.

turns.title: Subtle Anomalies
turns.facilitator_prompt: Introduce speed discrepancy and ghost AIS contact. Gauge whether players treat this as routine or begin investigating. Do not prompt — let them decide.

turns.title: Faulty Component / Increased Traffic
turns.facilitator_prompt: Faulty speed component identified with 5-min ETBOL. AIS traffic density rising. Watch whether players repair or press on — both are valid but carry different risk.
